response.justification: Bogdan has strong full-stack experience, deep technical breadth across languages (including C, C++, D, JavaScript/TypeScript), and a proven track record in building scalable systems and open-source tools, but lacks explicit evidence of leading experimentation platforms, AI-driven growth systems, or enterprise-scale feature flagging infrastructure — key requirements for the role.
strengths: Extensive hands-on experience with distributed systems and high-throughput services (e.g., millions of requests/sec at Dunnhumby).
Strong open-source contributions and tooling development (GISCollective, Fluent-Asserts, Trial) demonstrating initiative and systems thinking.
Proven ability to work across languages and stacks (C/C++, D, JS/TS, Java) and mentor others via workshops and code practices.
concerns: No clear evidence of building or leading experimentation frameworks, feature flighting, or growth measurement platforms.
Limited visibility into AI tooling usage for engineering velocity or data-driven decision systems as required.
Experience with telemetry and statistical analysis is implied but not explicitly documented or quantified.
